data.title: Jay Clayton likely to become AI czar under Trump with responsibilities for overseeing AI innovation and tech CEO supervision.
data.description: There is a possibility that Clayton, the US intelligence chief, could be tasked with overseeing not just the innovation and development of Artificial Intelligence (AI), but also ensuring that tech CEOs are self-regulating. This decision comes amidst growing concerns regarding privacy and security issues in the tech industry. Clayton may be required to handle these additional responsibilities in order to address the challenges posed by AI and the lack of self-regulation among tech companies. This move could potentially have a significant impact on the tech sector and its future development.
